name: Riverwalk House

tagline.en: Ann and Patrick’s Fáilte Ireland 4-star B&B by the river, a short riverside walk from the village of Oughterard.

mapQuery: Riverwalk House B&B, Oughterard, Co. Galway

en: Ann and Patrick welcome you to Riverwalk House, a Fáilte Ireland 4-star B&B in a quiet spot by the river. A short riverside walk brings you into the village of Oughterard, with its shops, pubs and restaurants.

Each of our three en-suite rooms is individually decorated, with tea and coffee, TV, hairdryer and toiletries. Guests tell us breakfast is the highlight: a full Irish cooked to order, or something lighter, with fresh fruit every morning.
We love helping you plan your days, from fishing on Lough Corrib and walks into Connemara to the best places for dinner and the most beautiful drives in the west.
ga: Cuireann Ann agus Patrick fáilte romhat go Riverwalk House, B&B 4 réalta Fáilte Ireland in áit chiúin cois abhann. Tugann siúlóid ghearr cois abhann isteach go sráidbhaile Uachtar Ard thú, lena shiopaí, a thithe tábhairne agus a bhialanna.

Tá gach ceann dár dtrí sheomra en suite maisithe ar a bhealach féin, le tae agus caife, teilifís, triomadóir gruaige agus earraí folctha. Deir aíonna linn gurb é an bricfeasta buaicphointe an lae: bricfeasta Éireannach iomlán réitithe duit féin, nó rud éigin níos éadroime, le torthaí úra gach maidin.
Is breá linn cabhrú leat do laethanta a phleanáil, ó iascaireacht ar Loch Coirib agus siúlóidí i gConamara go dtí na háiteanna is fearr don dinnéar agus na tiomántáin is áille san iarthar.
